injuries.shortComment: Gueye underwent surgery Tuesday to repair a fractured left foot that he suffered during a workout last week, Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network reports.

items.headline: Gueye underwent surgery Tuesday to repair a fractured left foot that he suffered during a workout last week, Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network reports.
items.text: Gueye will be re-evaluated by medical staff in 3-to-4 months, which means he'll miss all of training camp and preseason and likely the start of the 2026-27 regular season. It's a brutal blow for the fourth-year big man, given that the Hawks used the No. 23 overall pick of the 2026 NBA Draft to select St. John's product Zuby Ejiofor. Gueye's absence means Ejiofor will have more opportunities in the preseason, and the rookie could establish a key role off the bench behind Onyeka Okongwu and projected backup center Jock Landale (ankle).

injuries.shortComment: Veesaar was diagnosed with a torn right ACL and is expected to miss the 2026-27 season, the Hawks announced Monday.

items.headline: Veesaar was diagnosed with a torn right ACL and is expected to miss the 2026-27 season, the Hawks announced Monday.
items.text: Veesaar suffered the injury during a workout on Sept. 15, and an MRI confirmed the diagnosis. The No. 52 overall pick in the 2026 NBA Draft, Veesaar was expected to spend a lot of time with Atlanta's G League affiliate this season.

injuries.shortComment: Carter has been diagnosed with mononucleosis and is without a timetable for a return, Gary Washburn of The Boston Globe reports.

items.headline: Carter has been diagnosed with mononucleosis and is without a timetable for a return, Gary Washburn of The Boston Globe reports.
items.text: Carter missed Boston's final three preseason games with the illness and is now expected to miss time to begin the regular season. He can be considered week-to-week until Boston provides an update on his progress. The 2024 first-rounder signed a two-way pact with the Celtics on Saturday and will provide backcourt depth for the club.

injuries.shortComment: Head coach Jordi Fernandez said Brown (rest) will be held out of Sunday's game against the Pacers, Brian Lewis of the New York Post reports.

items.headline: Head coach Jordi Fernandez said Brown (rest) will be held out of Sunday's game against the Pacers, Brian Lewis of the New York Post reports.
items.text: Brown missed time in the preseason with an ankle injury and will sit out the second leg of this back-to-back set after posting eight points (3-10 FG, 2-6 3Pt), five assists, two rebounds and two steals across 20 minutes in Saturday's 125-121 loss to Cleveland. The rookie guard's next chance to play will come Tuesday at Boston, though he's expected to continue facing restrictions for the time being.

injuries.shortComment: Bilodeau (shoulder) has been ruled out for Saturday's game in Cleveland.

items.headline: Bilodeau (shoulder) has been ruled out for Saturday's game in Cleveland.
items.text: This will be Bilodeau's second straight game on the sidelines. His next chance to play will come Sunday against the Pacers.

injuries.shortComment: Williams (hamstring) has been ruled out for Saturday's game against the Heat.

items.headline: Williams (hamstring) has been ruled out for Saturday's game against the Heat.
items.text: Williams will miss each of the Hornets' first three games of the regular season due to a right hamstring strain that popped up during training camp in late September. Sion James will continue to operate in an elevated role in the absence of Williams, whose next chance to play is Monday against the Wizards.

injuries.shortComment: White (calf) has been ruled out for Saturday's game against Miami.

items.headline: White (calf) has been ruled out for Saturday's game against Miami.
items.text: White will miss a third straight game due to a left calf strain, though he's been ramping up in practice. His next chance to suit up will come Monday against the Wizards.

injuries.shortComment: Knueppel (hamstring) has been ruled out for Saturday's game against the Heat.

items.headline: Knueppel (hamstring) has been ruled out for Saturday's game against the Heat.
items.text: Knueppel will miss a third consecutive contest due to a left hamstring strain. The second-year swingman has been ramping up toward a return, and his next opportunity to play will come Monday against the Wizards.

injuries.shortComment: Boswell (knee) is out for Wednesday's season opener against the Nets.

items.headline: Boswell (knee) is out for Wednesday's season opener against the Nets.
items.text: Boswell continues to rehab after right knee surgery. The hope in early October was that he would be cleared for basketball activities prior to the start of the G League season, which begins in early November.

injuries.shortComment: Williams (groin) is out for Saturday's game versus the Wizards, Joel Lorenzi of The Athletic reports.

items.headline: Williams (groin) is out for Saturday's game versus the Wizards, Joel Lorenzi of The Athletic reports.
items.text: This will be Williams' first missed game this season due to injury. However, he hasn't been in the rotation, so Williams' absence from the active roster won't impact fantasy leagues.

injuries.shortComment: Essengue (head) won't suit up for Saturday's game against the Wizards, Joel Lorenzi of The Athletic reports.

items.headline: Essengue (head) won't suit up for Saturday's game against the Wizards, Joel Lorenzi of The Athletic reports.
items.text: Head coach Tiago Splitter said he's holding Essengue out of Saturday's game as a precaution, so it doesn't sound like he'll be out long. His next chance to play will come Monday in Boston.

injuries.shortComment: Claxton (hamstring) will be re-evaluated in two weeks, K.C. Johnson of Chicago Sports Network reports.

items.headline: Claxton (hamstring) will be re-evaluated in two weeks, K.C. Johnson of Chicago Sports Network reports.
items.text: This is a tough blow for the Bulls as they will be without their starting center for the first seven games of the regular season. Meanwhile, Zach Collins' (toe) status remains in the air. This could set up Jalen Smith for a solid workload to open the season.

injuries.shortComment: Irving is out for Saturday's game against the Spurs due to rest, Christian Clark of The Athletic reports.

items.headline: Irving is out for Saturday's game against the Spurs due to rest, Christian Clark of The Athletic reports.
items.text: The Mavericks are taking a cautious approach with Irving since he's played only a few games since returning from the ACL injury he sustained in March last year, so it's not surprising to see him out for rest. His next chance to play will come against the Heat on Monday, and in the meantime, Marcus Sasser is expected to replace him in the backcourt against the Spurs.

injuries.shortComment: Martin (thumb) has been ruled out against San Antonio on Saturday.

items.headline: Martin (thumb) has been ruled out against San Antonio on Saturday.
items.text: Martin has yet to suit up for a regular-season game due to a right thumb injury. His next chance to play is Monday against the Heat, but given the nature of the injury, he can be considered week-to-week until the Mavericks provide a more clear timetable for return.

injuries.shortComment: Biberovic (heel) has been ruled out for Saturday's game against San Antonio.

items.headline: Biberovic (heel) has been ruled out for Saturday's game against San Antonio.
items.text: Biberovic has been recovering from right heel bursitis stemming from training camp in mid-October. He'll end up missing the first three games of the regular season, and he can be considered week-to-week until the Mavericks provide a clearer timetable for the 2023 second-rounder.

injuries.shortComment: Aldama (knee) has been ruled out for Saturday's game against the Spurs.

items.headline: Aldama (knee) has been ruled out for Saturday's game against the Spurs.
items.text: Aldama continues to ramp up in his recovery from a right knee procedure that he underwent in March. His next chance to make his 2026-27 debut is Monday against the Heat, but he should be considered week-to-week until his practice participation increases.

injuries.shortComment: The Mavericks diagnosed Flagg with a mild left shoulder sprain, and the second-year forward will be re-evaluated by medical staff next week, Brett Siegel of ClutchPoints.com reports.

items.headline: The Mavericks diagnosed Flagg with a mild left shoulder sprain, and the second-year forward will be re-evaluated by medical staff next week, Brett Siegel of ClutchPoints.com reports.
items.text: Flagg took a hard fall during the second quarter of the Mavericks' win against the Pacers on Friday. He was already ruled out for Saturday's game against the Spurs, but it looks like the 2025 first-overall pick will miss at least a couple of more games while recovering from his injury. Naji Marshall, Marcus Sasser and Zaccharie Risacher figure to be the top candidates to enter Dallas' starting five for as long as Flagg is sidelined.

injuries.shortComment: Lively (foot) has been ruled out for Friday's game against the Pacers.

items.headline: Lively (foot) has been ruled out for Friday's game against the Pacers.
items.text: Lively underwent right foot surgery last December and remains without a clear timetable to return. The big man can be considered week-to-week until the Mavericks offer an update on his status. In the meantime, Moussa Cisse and Morez Johnson are candidates for increased minutes.

injuries.shortComment: Diallo (wrist) won't play Saturday against the Pelicans.

items.headline: Diallo (wrist) won't play Saturday against the Pelicans.
items.text: Diallo will hit the sidelines after hurting his wrist in Denver's season opener, which should open up minutes for Bryce Hopkins and Cam Whitmore. Diallo's next chance to play will come Monday against the Warriors.

injuries.shortComment: Head coach David Aldeman said that Johnson is "day-to-day" due to his sprained right ankle, Vinny Benedetto of The Denver Gazette reports.

items.headline: Head coach David Aldeman said that Johnson is "day-to-day" due to his sprained right ankle, Vinny Benedetto of The Denver Gazette reports.
items.text: Johnson won't play Saturday against the Pelicans, but it sounds like the ankle sprain he's dealing with his relatively minor. For now, Johnson should be considered questionable for Monday's meeting with the Warriors.

injuries.shortComment: Jones (hamstring) is out for Saturday's game against the Pelicans.

items.headline: Jones (hamstring) is out for Saturday's game against the Pelicans.
items.text: This will be Jones' second straight game on the sidelines. His next chance to play will come Monday versus the Warriors.

injuries.shortComment: Strawther (knee) was diagnosed with a left knee sprain Friday and will be re-evaluated in six weeks, Vinny Benedetto of The Denver Gazette reports.

items.headline: Strawther (knee) was diagnosed with a left knee sprain Friday and will be re-evaluated in six weeks, Vinny Benedetto of The Denver Gazette reports.
items.text: Strawther suffered the injury in Wednesday's preseason game against the Clippers. The 24-year-old has appeared in 172 regular-season games for the Nuggets since entering the league in 2023, averaging 7.1 points, 2.0 rebounds and 1.1 assists over 16.2 minutes per contest. He was in line to compete for an expanded role during the 2026-27 campaign. While that may be the case once Strawther is cleared to suit up, Tyus Jones and potentially Ryan Nembhard are candidates to receive more minutes in the interim.

injuries.shortComment: Thompson (ankle) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against Philadelphia.

items.headline: Thompson (ankle) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against Philadelphia.
items.text: Thompson sustained a right ankle sprain in the third quarter of Friday's win over Miami and did not return. If the 23-year-old forward is ultimately ruled out, Isaiah Joe and Javonte Green would likely see increased playing time.

injuries.shortComment: Duren has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the 76ers due to a right hamstring strain, Eric Vincent of ClutchPoints.com reports.

items.headline: Duren has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the 76ers due to a right hamstring strain, Eric Vincent of ClutchPoints.com reports.
items.text: Duren exited Friday's win over Miami early and did not return, and he's since been diagnosed with a hamstring strain. With the star big man sidelined, Paul Reed is expected to start and figures to see a significant increase in minutes.

injuries.shortComment: Green (back) won't play Saturday in Phoenix.

items.headline: Green (back) won't play Saturday in Phoenix.
items.text: Green is sitting out the second leg of this back-to-back set, but he should return for Monday's meeting in Denver. Graham Ike, Georges Niang and Gui Santos will help pick up the slack with Green inactive.

injuries.shortComment: Horford (back) has been ruled out for Saturday's game against the Suns.

items.headline: Horford (back) has been ruled out for Saturday's game against the Suns.
items.text: As expected, the veteran big man will sit out the second leg of this back-to-back set due to lower-back injury management. With Draymond Green (back/rest) expected to join Horford on the inactive list, Graham Ike and Georges Niang are candidates for increased burn, especially if Charles Bassey (knee) is downgraded from questionable to out.

injuries.shortComment: Curry (rest) won't play Saturday against the Suns.

items.headline: Curry (rest) won't play Saturday against the Suns.
items.text: Curry told reporters after Friday's loss to the Grizzlies that he will "probably not" play Saturday, and the star floor general won't suit up in the second leg of this back-to-back set. With Curry out, a committee of De'Anthony Melton, Will Richard, Brandon Williams and Gary Payton will cover his minutes in the Warriors' backcourt. Curry will aim to return against the Nuggets on Monday.

injuries.shortComment: Podziemski (back) told reporters Friday that he will not play in the second leg of the Warriors' back-to-back set Saturday against the Suns, Nick Friedell of The Athletic reports.

items.headline: Podziemski (back) told reporters Friday that he will not play in the second leg of the Warriors' back-to-back set Saturday against the Suns, Nick Friedell of The Athletic reports.
items.text: Podziemski missed the Warriors' regular-season opener against the Lakers on Wednesday due to back soreness, but he was cleared to play against the Grizzlies on Friday, when he played 33 minutes and finished with 18 points (7-17 FG, 2-8 3Pt, 2-2 FT), three assists, two rebounds, three steals and one block in a 111-108 loss. Stephen Curry (rest) is unlikely to play Saturday, so the Warriors' starting backcourt figures to be made up of some combination of De'Anthony Melton, Will Richard, Brandon Williams and Gary Payton. Podziemski's next chance to play is Monday against the Nuggets.

injuries.shortComment: Porzingis is contemplating his future in basketball as he deals with recurring symptoms from the autoimmune condition termed as postural orthostatic tachycardia syndrome, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

items.headline: Porzingis is contemplating his future in basketball as he deals with recurring symptoms from the autoimmune condition termed as postural orthostatic tachycardia syndrome, per Shams Charania of ESPN.
items.text: Charania also notes Golden State has started exploring trade routes for Porzingis, who is already considered out indefinitely to begin the 2026-27 season. Fantasy managers shouldn't expect the big man to get back on the floor anytime soon, whether it be for the Warriors or perhaps another team, and it sounds like stepping away from the game is on the table for Porzingis at this point.

injuries.shortComment: Moody (knee) is progressing toward a potential return between December and January after rupturing his left patellar tendon in March, Anthony Slater of ESPN reports.

items.headline: Moody (knee) is progressing toward a potential return between December and January after rupturing his left patellar tendon in March, Anthony Slater of ESPN reports.
items.text: Moody has been limited to individual court work, but team sources indicate he's ahead of Jimmy Butler (knee) in the rehabilitation process and is expected to return before the veteran forward. The 24-year-old still has several recovery checkpoints to complete, and Golden State has not established an official timetable. His eventual return would help replenish a Warriors wing rotation that will open the season without both Moody and Butler.

injuries.shortComment: Butler (knee) could return sometime between January and February as he continues recovering from a torn right ACL, Anthony Slater of ESPN reports.

items.headline: Butler (knee) could return sometime between January and February as he continues recovering from a torn right ACL, Anthony Slater of ESPN reports.
items.text: Butler, who underwent surgery after suffering the injury Jan. 19, has progressed to individual court work but still has several rehabilitation milestones to clear. His next step involves landing comfortably after a game-speed jump. Coach Steve Kerr is hopeful Butler can rejoin Golden State for the latter portion of the season, though no official return date has been announced. The 37-year-old forward remains a significant part of the Warriors' plans and could provide a substantial boost during the second half of the campaign.

injuries.shortComment: Smart (forearm) has been ruled out for Saturday's game against the Hawks, Varun Shankar of the Houston Chronicle reports.

items.headline: Smart (forearm) has been ruled out for Saturday's game against the Hawks, Varun Shankar of the Houston Chronicle reports.
items.text: Smart will be held out of the second leg of this back-to-back set due to a left forearm strain. The veteran guard will join Fred VanVleet (knee/rest) on the inactive list, opening up minutes for Reed Sheppard, Bruce Thornton and Bogdan Bogdanovic.

injuries.shortComment: Adams (ankle) has been ruled out for Saturday's game against the Hawks.

items.headline: Adams (ankle) has been ruled out for Saturday's game against the Hawks.
items.text: As expected, Adams will sit out the second leg of this back-to-back set due to left ankle injury management. His next chance to play will come in Monday's rematch versus the Hawks. With the veteran big man out, Clint Capela will likely see a bump in minutes.

injuries.shortComment: VanVleet (knee) has been ruled out for Saturday's game against the Hawks.

items.headline: VanVleet (knee) has been ruled out for Saturday's game against the Hawks.
items.text: VanVleet will sit out the second leg of this back-to-back set due to right knee injury management, though he'll likely be able to return for Monday's rematch with Atlanta. In the meantime, Marcus Smart and Reed Sheppard (knee), who is listed as questionable, are candidates for increased burn. If Sheppard is also ruled out, Bruce Thornton could join the rotation.

injuries.shortComment: Nesmith (hamstring) is listed as probable for Sunday's game against Brooklyn.

items.headline: Nesmith (hamstring) is listed as probable for Sunday's game against Brooklyn.
items.text: Nesmith made his regular-season debut in Friday's loss to the Mavericks, ditching his questionable tag due to a left hamstring strain. He played limited minutes off the bench in his return and could be on a minutes restriction if he's cleared to play Sunday. If the 27-year-old wing remains limited or is ultimately ruled out, Jarace Walker and Kelly Oubre could see increased minutes.

injuries.shortComment: McConnell (hamstring) is out for Sunday's game against the Nets.

items.headline: McConnell (hamstring) is out for Sunday's game against the Nets.
items.text: McConnell has yet to make his season debut for the Pacers as he tries to work his way back from a hamstring strain. His next chance to make his season debut will be in the second leg of this back-to-back set Monday at Milwaukee.

injuries.shortComment: Sheppard has been diagnosed with a torn meniscus in his left knee and is without a timetable for a return to game action, Scott Agness of FieldhouseFiles.com reports.

items.headline: Sheppard has been diagnosed with a torn meniscus in his left knee and is without a timetable for a return to game action, Scott Agness of FieldhouseFiles.com reports.
items.text: Sheppard can be considered out indefinitely until the Pacers offer an update on his timeline to return. In the meantime, Jarace Walker and Quenton Jackson will likely see increased playing time.

injuries.shortComment: Furphy was diagnosed with a torn right ACL on Monday and will miss the remainder of the season, Michael Scotto of USA Today reports.

items.headline: Furphy was diagnosed with a torn right ACL on Monday and will miss the remainder of the season, Michael Scotto of USA Today reports.
items.text: Furphy started in 21 of 35 regular-season appearances for the Pacers, posting averages of 5.1 points, 4.4 rebounds, 1.2 assists and 0.7 three-pointers in 18.4 minutes per contest. While no timetable has been announced, Furphy's absence could extend through the beginning of the 2026-27 season. With this news, the Pacers will likely lean more on Ben Sheppard, Kam Jones and Quenton Jackson moving forward.

injuries.shortComment: Beal (knee) will not be ready for the start of the regular season, NBA writer Justin Russo reports.

items.headline: Beal (knee) will not be ready for the start of the regular season, NBA writer Justin Russo reports.
items.text: Beal is dealing with knee inflammation that will keep him sidelined for Opening Night. While it's unclear how long the Clippers will be without the veteran guard, Darius Garland, Keaton Wagler and Kris Dunn should dominate the backcourt minutes in his absence. Beal's 2025-26 campaign was cut short by a hip injury after he averaged 8.2 points and 1.7 assists in 20.6 minutes across just six regular-season appearances.

injuries.shortComment: Strus has been diagnosed with a partially torn plantar fascia in his right foot and he will be re-evaluated in four weeks, Ohm Youngmisuk of ESPN.com reports.

items.headline: Strus has been diagnosed with a partially torn plantar fascia in his right foot and he will be re-evaluated in four weeks, Ohm Youngmisuk of ESPN.com reports.
items.text: Plantar fascia injuries can be tricky to recover from, with the only remedy typically being prolonged rest, so don't be surprised if Strus' absence extends well beyond this initial four-week window. With Strus now set to miss at least the first few weeks of the season, and Bradley Beal (knee) uncertain for opening night, Keaton Wagler could be thrust into the first unit sooner than expected.

injuries.shortComment: Niederhauser (foot) won't be ready for the start of the season, Law Murray of The Athletic reports.

items.headline: Niederhauser (foot) won't be ready for the start of the season, Law Murray of The Athletic reports.
items.text: Niederhauser is progressing from March surgery but won't be able to suit up to begin the year. The Clippers are likely to take a cautious approach with the 2025 first-rounder. Isaiah Jackson should occupy the backup center spot behind Brook Lopez early in the campaign.

injuries.shortComment: Ingram won't be ready for the start of the season due to a partially torn Achilles, per Joey Linn of SI.com.

items.headline: Ingram won't be ready for the start of the season due to a partially torn Achilles, per Joey Linn of SI.com.
items.text: The Clippers learned about the injury this summer, though it's unclear exactly how far along Ingram is in his recovery. The star forward's timeline for a return is unclear, clouding his fantasy outlook in the meantime. Darius Garland should take on all the usage he can handle in Ingram's stead, while Kris Dunn and Max Strus could have additional streaming appeal early in the year.

injuries.shortComment: Miller underwent surgery Wednesday to repair a torn left rotator cuff and will be re-evaluated in six months, per Law Murray of The Athletic.

items.headline: Miller underwent surgery Wednesday to repair a torn left rotator cuff and will be re-evaluated in six months, per Law Murray of The Athletic.
items.text: It's a tough break for Miller, who had an opportunity to battle for a reserve role during training camp in the fall. The timeline for a return is likely to keep him on the shelf until after the All-Star break. Miller's extended stay on the sidelines gives Kobe Sanders a chance to crack the Clippers' rotation.

injuries.shortComment: Thiero (knee) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against Utah, Khobi Price of The California Post reports.

items.headline: Thiero (knee) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against Utah, Khobi Price of The California Post reports.
items.text: Thiero will miss a third straight game due to a left knee effusion. His next opportunity to play will come Tuesday against the Trail Blazers.

injuries.shortComment: Carr (oblique) is out for Sunday's game in Utah, Khobi Price of The California Post reports.

items.headline: Carr (oblique) is out for Sunday's game in Utah, Khobi Price of The California Post reports.
items.text: This will be Carr's third straight game on the inactive list. His next chance to play will come Tuesday against the Trail Blazers, the first game of a back-to-back set.

injuries.shortComment: Coward (wrist) is questionable for Sunday's game in Sacramento.

items.headline: Coward (wrist) is questionable for Sunday's game in Sacramento.
items.text: Coward sat out Friday's 111-108 win over the Warriors due to the wrist issue, which resulted in GG Jackson drawing the start, and Jerami Grant saw a minor bump in minutes. It will likely be more of the same if Coward gets ruled out again.

injuries.shortComment: Edey has been ruled out for Sunday's game against Sacramento due to left ankle injury management.

items.headline: Edey has been ruled out for Sunday's game against Sacramento due to left ankle injury management.
items.text: Edey will sit out the front end of this back-to-back set. With the big man unavailable, Isaiah Stewart and Quinten Post are candidates to see increased playing time.

injuries.shortComment: DiVincenzo (Achilles) remains confident that he'll return during the 2026-27 season, Jon Krawczynski of The Athletic reports.

items.headline: DiVincenzo (Achilles) remains confident that he'll return during the 2026-27 season, Jon Krawczynski of The Athletic reports.
items.text: DiVincenzo is approaching six months since tearing his right Achilles during the first round of the playoffs and has been rehabbing with the expectation that he'll play at some point this season. The veteran guard has sought advice from Jayson Tatum, Tyrese Haliburton and Damian Lillard during his recovery, though Minnesota has yet to establish a timetable for his return.

injuries.shortComment: Missi has been diagnosed with a left knee bone bruise and he will miss an extended period of time, Brett Siegel of ClutchPoints.com reports.

items.headline: Missi has been diagnosed with a left knee bone bruise and he will miss an extended period of time, Brett Siegel of ClutchPoints.com reports.
items.text: Missi currently has no official timetable for his return, but he appears likely to miss significant time. Derik Queen could be elevated into a starting role while Missi is sidelined, so make sure he's not floating around on your waiver wire. Missi doesn't offer enough upside to warrant holding onto in re-draft fantasy leagues.

injuries.shortComment: Alvarado is questionable for Sunday's game against Orlando due to a left ankle sprain.

items.headline: Alvarado is questionable for Sunday's game against Orlando due to a left ankle sprain.
items.text: Alvarado may have tweaked his ankle during the Knicks' 107-103 loss to the Celtics on Friday, when he played 11 minutes and finished with two points, two rebounds, two assists and one steal. Miles McBride, Jordan Clarkson and Tyler Kolek would all be in line for an uptick in minutes off the bench if Alvarado cannot play Sunday.

injuries.shortComment: The Thunder plan to waive Oweh (Achilles) on Friday.

items.headline: The Thunder plan to waive Oweh (Achilles) on Friday.
items.text: Oweh, a rookie second-round pick, was set to be a two-way player for Oklahoma City but suffered a ruptured right Achilles tendon in a preseason game, which will sideline him for the entire 2026-27 campaign. Following a long road to recovery, Oweh might have to settle for an Exhibit 10 deal next summer.

injuries.shortComment: Topic (back) won't play in Thursday's game against the Nuggets.

items.headline: Topic (back) won't play in Thursday's game against the Nuggets.
items.text: Topic is out again Thursday, as expected. He doesn't have a definitive return date, so he should be considered week-to-week.

injuries.shortComment: Sorber (knee) is listed as out for Thursday's game against Denver.

items.headline: Sorber (knee) is listed as out for Thursday's game against Denver.
items.text: Sorber is still working his way back from offseason knee surgery and remains without a firm return date. He should be considered week-to-week until there is a more definitive update.

injuries.shortComment: Isaac (knee) has been ruled out ahead of Sunday's game against the Knicks.

items.headline: Isaac (knee) has been ruled out ahead of Sunday's game against the Knicks.
items.text: Isaac continues to be sidelined by a left knee injury that caused him to miss the final two months of the 2025-26 season. He has yet to make his 2026-27 debut, and his next chance to do so is Wednesday against the Raptors.

injuries.shortComment: Black (ankle) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Knicks.

items.headline: Black (ankle) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Knicks.
items.text: Black has a chance to return to action Sunday after missing Orlando's first two regular-season games. If the 22-year-old guard is cleared to play, Jase Richardson and Jevon Carter would likely see fewer minutes.

injuries.shortComment: Banchero is expected to be sidelined for the next four-to-six weeks due to a right high-ankle sprain, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

items.headline: Banchero is expected to be sidelined for the next four-to-six weeks due to a right high-ankle sprain, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.
items.text: Banchero left during Friday's loss against the Timberwolves due to an ankle injury, and follow-up tests have confirmed a high-ankle sprain for the fifth-year forward. With an extended absence expected, the Magic will have to rely more heavily on Franz Wagner and Desmond Bane offensively, and Tristan da Silva figures to be the top candidate to enter the Magic's starting lineup for as long as Banchero is sidelined.

injuries.shortComment: Penda was diagnosed with a partially torn right hamstring Saturday, Jason Beede of the Orlando Sentinel reports.

items.headline: Penda was diagnosed with a partially torn right hamstring Saturday, Jason Beede of the Orlando Sentinel reports.
items.text: Penda suffered the hamstring tear in Friday's 136-115 preseason win over the Heat. It's unknown how long the injury will keep the 21-year-old off the floor. However, since it's a different injury than the one he suffered in the same hamstring during training camp, the team may take a cautious approach regarding his return. Penda, the No. 32 overall pick in the 2025 NBA Draft, averaged 3.8 points, 3.2 rebounds and 1.2 assists over 12.8 minutes per outing in 59 regular-season games in 2025-26. While he's not expected to be a mainstay in the rotation throughout the 2026-27 campaign, his absence could open up a few minutes for Tristan Da Silva.

injuries.shortComment: Team president Jeff Weltman said Monday that Nelson (ankle) remains about a month away from returning to the court after offseason surgery, per Philip Rossman-Reich of OrlandoMagicDaily.com.

items.headline: Team president Jeff Weltman said Monday that Nelson (ankle) remains about a month away from returning to the court after offseason surgery, per Philip Rossman-Reich of OrlandoMagicDaily.com.
items.text: With Nelson still in recovery mode from the left ankle surgery he underwent this summer, his path back to game action remains delayed for the early part of the season. The rookie big man is on a two-way contract with the Magic, so his short-term absence mainly affects his developmental timeline rather than Orlando's regular rotation.

injuries.shortComment: Embiid produced 28 points (8-20 FG, 0-3 3Pt, 12-14 FT), 11 rebounds, 10 assists, one steal and four turnovers across 36 minutes in Saturday's 127-116 win over the Bucks.

items.headline: Embiid produced 28 points (8-20 FG, 0-3 3Pt, 12-14 FT), 11 rebounds, 10 assists, one steal and four turnovers across 36 minutes in Saturday's 127-116 win over the Bucks.
items.text: Embiid notched his first triple-double of the year, setting season highs in points and dimes to go with a plus-18 differential in the win. Embiid said Thursday that he only intended to play in one game of the 76ers' back-to-back set, so managers should be prepared for him to sit out Sunday's meeting with the Pistons.

injuries.shortComment: Walker (ankle) exited Saturday's 127-116 win over the Bucks in the third quarter and did not return, finishing with six points (2-3 FG, 2-3 FT), three rebounds, one assist and one steal across 12 minutes.

items.headline: Walker (ankle) exited Saturday's 127-116 win over the Bucks in the third quarter and did not return, finishing with six points (2-3 FG, 2-3 FT), three rebounds, one assist and one steal across 12 minutes.
items.text: Walker logged a season-high 12 minutes in the absence of LeBron James (back), though the former appeared to turn his ankle in the third quarter and never checked back in. Walker can be considered questionable for Sunday's game against Detroit until more information comes to light.

injuries.shortComment: James (back) has been ruled out for Saturday's game against the Bucks, Adam Aaronson of PhillyVoice.com reports.

items.headline: James (back) has been ruled out for Saturday's game against the Bucks, Adam Aaronson of PhillyVoice.com reports.
items.text: James will be held out of the front end of this back-to-back set, with his next chance to play coming Sunday against Detroit. With the star forward sidelined, Dean Wade (ankle), Jabari Walker and Kentavious Caldwell-Pope are candidates for increased playing time.

injuries.shortComment: Fall (quadriceps) is out for Saturday's game against the Bucks.

items.headline: Fall (quadriceps) is out for Saturday's game against the Bucks.
items.text: Fall still isn't ready for his 76ers debut due to a quadriceps strain. Once cleared to make his season debut, the two-way player could see most of his action come with the G League's Delaware Blue Coats.

injuries.shortComment: Barlow will miss at least the next two weeks of action due to a lumbar spine bone stress response, Adam Aaronson of PhillyVoice.com reports.

items.headline: Barlow will miss at least the next two weeks of action due to a lumbar spine bone stress response, Adam Aaronson of PhillyVoice.com reports.
items.text: The back issue cost Barlow the entire preseason, and now he'll begin the regular season on the sidelines. The earliest we could see Barlow back on the court would be Nov. 2, but it wouldn't be shocking to see his absence extend beyond this loose, two-week window.

injuries.shortComment: Hukporti has sustained a season-ending ruptured right Achilles tendon, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

items.headline: Hukporti has sustained a season-ending ruptured right Achilles tendon, per Shams Charania of ESPN.
items.text: Hukporti went down with an Achilles injury in Monday's preseason opener against the Knicks, and an MRI has since revealed a rupture. He signed a one-year deal with the 76ers over the summer, so Hukporti will be an unrestricted free agent come season's end. With Hukporti's year already finished, Adem Bona (foot) should assume the backup center role behind Joel Embiid once healthy.

injuries.shortComment: Ighodaro (oblique) has been ruled out for Saturday's game against the Warriors, Duane Rankin of The Arizona Republic reports.

items.headline: Ighodaro (oblique) has been ruled out for Saturday's game against the Warriors, Duane Rankin of The Arizona Republic reports.
items.text: As expected, Ighodaro will miss Saturday's contest with an oblique strain. The big man's next opportunity to play will come Monday at Oklahoma City. With Ighodaro sidelined, Koa Peat, Rasheer Fleming and Duop Reath could see increased minutes at the five. Khaman Maluach is expected to remain in the first unit and could also see a bump in minutes.

injuries.shortComment: Williams underwent surgery Thursday to repair a torn labrum in his left shoulder and will miss an extended period of time, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

items.headline: Williams underwent surgery Thursday to repair a torn labrum in his left shoulder and will miss an extended period of time, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.
items.text: This is a tough blow for the center with training camp right around the corner. With his status for Opening Night in jeopardy, this will put a lot of eyes on Oso Ighodaro and Khaman Maluach, with the latter already drawing buzz during the Summer League. More clarity on Williams' timeline should be known in the coming weeks.

injuries.shortComment: Youngblood (ankle) is out for Friday's game against the Kings.

items.headline: Youngblood (ankle) is out for Friday's game against the Kings.
items.text: Youngblood will have to wait to make his 2026-27 season debut, and he'll miss a second consecutive game while dealing with left ankle soreness. His next chance to play will come against the Lakers on Tuesday, Nov. 27.

injuries.shortComment: Carlson (concussion) has been ruled out for Friday's game against Sacramento.

items.headline: Carlson (concussion) has been ruled out for Friday's game against Sacramento.
items.text: Carlson is still in the league's concussion protocol and will remain on the inactive list for a second consecutive contest to begin the regular season. The big man's next opportunity to play will come Tuesday against the Lakers.

injuries.shortComment: Sharpe suffered a torn meniscus in his knee and is expected to miss six months, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

items.headline: Sharpe suffered a torn meniscus in his knee and is expected to miss six months, per Shams Charania of ESPN.
items.text: It's a tough blow to the Trail Blazers' depth on the wing ahead of training camp. Sharpe, who is now likely to be sidelined until after the All-Star break, had been ticketed for a reserve role behind Toumani Camara following an injury-plagued 2025-26 campaign, which saw average a career-high 20.8 points, 1.4 steals and 2.1 three-pointers per game over 50 regular-season appearances. The door is now open for Vit Krejci and Jeremy Sochan to compete for bench minutes during camp.

injuries.shortComment: Murray is questionable to play Sunday against the Grizzlies due to left ankle capsulitis.

items.headline: Murray is questionable to play Sunday against the Grizzlies due to left ankle capsulitis.
items.text: A final call on Murray's availability for Sunday will be made closer to Sunday's 9 p.m. ET tipoff. If he's not available to play, then Precious Achiuwa and potentially Alex Karaban could be in line to see more playing time at power forward.

injuries.shortComment: Simmons underwent successful surgery Tuesday to repair a torn right Achilles tendon, James Ham of ESPN 1320 Sacramento reports.

items.headline: Simmons underwent successful surgery Tuesday to repair a torn right Achilles tendon, James Ham of ESPN 1320 Sacramento reports.
items.text: Simmons had a quality preseason, averaging 10.5 points, 4.0 rebounds and 4.0 assists over 17.4 minutes per contest (two games). The 30-year-old was on track to suit up for the Kings on opening night, though those plans were halted after he suffered a torn Achilles tendon during practice. Now, Simmons will focus on rehab. However, it's unknown what the future holds regarding his career in the NBA.

injuries.shortComment: Cardwell (calf) is expected to miss at least the first five or six games of the regular season, with a longer absence possible, Frankie Cartoscelli of KHTK Sactown Sports 1140 reports.

items.headline: Cardwell (calf) is expected to miss at least the first five or six games of the regular season, with a longer absence possible, Frankie Cartoscelli of KHTK Sactown Sports 1140 reports.
items.text: Cardwell appeared in 44 games last season, providing frontcourt depth while Domantas Sabonis dealt with injuries. Sacramento will also be without Maxime Raynaud (knee) to begin the campaign, leaving the team thin at center behind Sabonis. Cardwell's return timetable remains uncertain, but his absence could create additional opportunities for the Kings' remaining frontcourt reserves.

injuries.shortComment: Raynaud (knee) is expected to miss at least the first five or six games of the regular season, and potentially longer, Frankie Cartoscelli of KHTK Sactown Sports 1140 reports.

items.headline: Raynaud (knee) is expected to miss at least the first five or six games of the regular season, and potentially longer, Frankie Cartoscelli of KHTK Sactown Sports 1140 reports.
items.text: Raynaud is recovering from a right patellar subluxation and appears set to begin the campaign on the sidelines. The young center appeared in 74 games last season, helping anchor Sacramento's frontcourt while Domantas Sabonis battled injuries. With Dylan Cardwell also sidelined, the Kings will be especially dependent on Sabonis until their reserve centers return.

injuries.shortComment: Harris (calf) is out for Saturday's game against the Mavericks.

items.headline: Harris (calf) is out for Saturday's game against the Mavericks.
items.text: Harris has yet to play for the Spurs this season, and this will be a third consecutive absence for the veteran forward. With Harris on the sidelines, Devin Vassell and Julian Champagnie should be in line for more playing time Saturday and beyond.

injuries.shortComment: Quaintance has been around the team but has not yet been cleared for basketball activities, Matt Guzman of SI.com reports.

items.headline: Quaintance has been around the team but has not yet been cleared for basketball activities, Matt Guzman of SI.com reports.
items.text: The Spurs are expected to exercise extreme caution with the big man, as Quaintance suffered a torn ACL and meniscus with Arizona State in February 2025 before appearing in only four games with Kentucky last season due to severe complications and persistent swelling. The 19-year-old underwent a cleanup procedure on his meniscus in mid-July, and the Spurs will likely want him at 100 percent before ramping him up to basketball activities.

injuries.shortComment: Bittle (foot) is out for Wednesday's season opener against the Bulls.

items.headline: Bittle (foot) is out for Wednesday's season opener against the Bulls.
items.text: Bittle, who just landed a two-way deal with Toronto, continues to recover from a foot fracture. The rookie big man didn't appear in the preseason and has no timetable for a return to the floor.

injuries.shortComment: Alexander won't play Wednesday against the Grizzlies due to a left knee bone bruise.

items.headline: Alexander won't play Wednesday against the Grizzlies due to a left knee bone bruise.
items.text: Alexander sat out Friday's preseason finale with what the team initially described as a left knee injury, but we now know he's dealing with a bone bruise. Don't be surprised if Alexander misses Friday's game against the Pelicans as well.

injuries.shortComment: Nurkic will miss at least the next four weeks due to a partial plantar plate tear of second toe in right foot, Chris Haynes of NBA TV reports.

items.headline: Nurkic will miss at least the next four weeks due to a partial plantar plate tear of second toe in right foot, Chris Haynes of NBA TV reports.
items.text: Nurkic will begin the 2026-27 season on the sidelines, and given the tricky nature of foot injuries for big men, it wouldn't be shocking to see his absence extend beyond this initial four-week window. Jaren Jackson will likely spend more time at center while Nurkic is out, and there will be more minutes available for Jaxson Hayes and Mo Bamba.

injuries.shortComment: Dybantsa (ankle) has been ruled out for Saturday's game against the Bulls.

items.headline: Dybantsa (ankle) has been ruled out for Saturday's game against the Bulls.
items.text: Dybantsa will miss a third straight game due to a left ankle sprain, with his next chance to make his regular-season debut coming Monday at Charlotte. Bilal Coulibaly, Tre Johnson and Khris Middleton are candidates to see an uptick in minutes in Dybantsa's stead.

injuries.shortComment: The Wizards announced Thursday that Vukcevic (hip) will be re-evaluated in four weeks.

items.headline: The Wizards announced Thursday that Vukcevic (hip) will be re-evaluated in four weeks.
items.text: Although the big man will remain a limited participant in training camp as he continues his rehab from a hip impingement, it sounds like his absence from game action will extend into the regular season. Deandre Ayton should have the backup center role all to himself until Vukcevic is cleared to retake the floor.

injuries.shortComment: The Wizards announced Thursday that Watkins has undergone surgery for a torn ACL.

items.headline: The Wizards announced Thursday that Watkins has undergone surgery for a torn ACL.
items.text: Watkins, a two-way player for the Wizards, suffered the injury during the Summer League. Although Washington has yet to offer a timetable for a return, a typical recovery time for the procedure is approximately 9-to-12 months. That leaves Watkins in serious jeopardy of missing most, if not all, of the 2026-27 season, and it remains to be seen if the team will continue keeping him around on a two-way roster spot while he's injured.
